title: Land recoverable DATA/PRIMARY publication and joint vacuum for MVCC
body:
> **Host transfer:** execution is moving to `.185` tmux `gomap-mvcc-4871`; both previous workers are stopped and checkpointed. [Exact source, evidence, ownership and continuation](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6196062019). Previous host/owner statements below are historical.

[Detailed decision and paired summaries](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6193413716).

Readonly owned counting and actual asserted PRIMARY capture after Close pass; platform implementation fixes still require Windows/macOS runtime. The sole Sol6.1 writer owns remaining compatible platform/caller fixes. The unchanged original vacuum fixture now proves three disjoint copies of one297-page DATA base,594 redundant pages. The writer is implementing construction-local common-base reuse through existing fresh COW, preserving every recovery version/page lifetime and the40% shrink target. The original nonlast-release guard also reproduced one avoidable allocation; shared locked scalar consumption is selected. Complete CI logs ruled out the speculative deferred-guard change for the two completion-flag failures. Preserve exact both-slot protection, old readers, physical reclamation, allocation/shrink thresholds and original durability gates. Reuse maintained ownership/arena domains; no substitute publisher, registry or pool. Batch compatible causes before one product push, then required CI and independent Sol review.

Root owns Git/GitHub/acceptance/merge. Published b3c7 CI remains32success/20failure; local focused evidence does not replace it. [Canonical state](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6157916554) owns current leases. Native#4878 remains frozen pending shared seam stabilization, with Q32RED/publicACK0 and actual visible-install/fence/Finish integration open. All historical acceptance gates below remain required.

**Hard cleanup failure versus work refusal (2026-10-14 source decision):** In the two original packed-prepare ambiguity controls, the destination child has already been unlinked when `BeforeDeletionDirectorySync` returns an injected hard error; the physical directory Sync has not started. Keep the selected first-hard-failure contract: the SAME authority, original parent handle, positive namespace proof, exact staging root and charged debt remain reachable through the existing DB cleanup-error receipt. Terminal/concurrent/repeated DB.Close reports the original cause and does not replay the rollback or construct reopened cleanup operands. Revise only `TestLeafGenerationPackStablePrepareValidationCleanupAmbiguityRetainsAndRetries` and `TestLeafGenerationPackStablePrepareValidationCleanupAmbiguityConcurrentClose` to assert actual authorized unlink, zero physical Sync after that hard refusal, exactly one cleanup attempt, original errors and retained exact custody; preserve their original RED/baseline retry evidence and document the deliberate expectation change. A pre-effect native work-budget refusal is distinct and must resume the unstarted effect on the SAME admitted state. No fault, format, recovery, ownership, charging or physical-Finish gate is waived.

<!-- mvcc-shared-custody-completion-20261014 -->
**Remaining ordinary completion scope (2026-10-14):** Complete the SAME existing RecoverableRootSet and leafGenerationPackPromotionAuthority containing admission and first-outcome/progress contract. Preserve unresolved original aliases and charged capacity through the existing DB error receipt before discovery loss; clear/refund only actually consumed constituents. Checked startup/capture/retry/release and pack/candidate cleanup are required production callers. No replacement owner, keeper, replay or second physical authority. Genuine prepared-pack integration RED identifies generic packed/DATA builder ownership versus the admitted manifest producer: migrate through maintained same-DB-registry metadata import and builder APIs, preserving original physical custody. Existing prepared-closure normal/race GREEN remains component evidence.

Native #4878 owns the explicitly frozen/released original shared paths recorded in the executor state, including BuildGroup/Coordinator, Pager constructors, index-generation teardown and namespace tokens. The ordinary owner keeps these paths read-only until verified back-integration. Other ordinary imports remain read-only. Generic SAME File/Set/Arena/Pager/retainedalloc.Owner cleanup engines must back-integrate into this foundation before freeze/full qualification, without a native application/Request dependency. Finish the finite remaining callers and same-authority batch namespace constructor, then all19/outer-leaf normal/race, format/fault, shrink/output, matched cost, platform/current-head CI and independent review. Every existing gate and protected source/fixture remains. Current handoff/ownership/evidence: [executor state](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6157916554).

<!-- mvcc-coherent-production-repair:20261013:start -->
**Active #5111 structural repair, 2026-10-13.** Sole coordinator/acceptance `/root`; one GPT-6.1 Sol implementation writer. Complete the production-used ordinary DATA/PRIMARY closure and all existing gates before native #4878 merges. Consume merged C3-read #5076 and measurement #5118; retain PR #5127 draft and useful checkpoint source. The latest unpublished `8f20fd204` packet remains protected in the offline execution workspace; recover/reconcile exact bytes before incorporating or crediting it. No source reconstruction from checkpoint prose.

Reuse `DurableRootTransaction`, existing allocation/lineage/registry and original owners across ordinary producers, immutable logical readers, owned promotion, recovery and physical cleanup. The ordinary deliverable is the complete actual descriptor/native consumer prerequisite, not every historically proposed witness API. Defer unused native proof/control APIs; preserve all19 groups, format/fault, shrink/output, cost/CI/platform gates. Initially reproduce the actual original COW build-group constructor disposal defect, audit all sibling producer/consumer/lifetime seams and repair one coherent ownership packet. No localized discount or pool can replace actual completion.

#5111 supplies the accepted producer ordering/resource closure and SAME transaction contract consumed by #4878 and #5047. That dependency is not satisfied by certificates, component passes or a capped-refusal demonstration. The [active parent revision](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871) owns current scheduling; historical checkpoints below retain evidence without overriding this execution state.

**Production-path decision (source-bound inquiry accepted 2026-10-13):** Retain the existing C1/C3 immutable composite cut: ordered cache shard/frozen roots plus its exactly captured backend snapshot. Foreground command-WAL writes publish C1; PRIMARY construction legitimately runs during physical flush/checkpoint/replay. Zero foreground constructor events are not an integration failure. The current public command-WAL + `cow_btree` cost fixture also records zero PRIMARY dispatch during DirtyCheckpoint because `IndexPrimaryDirectory` is unset; that is the selection gap. #5111 will select the existing PRIMARY format for the main backend of this configuration, after side-store options have been constructed, and prove actual foreground C1 publication, physical PRIMARY construction/promotion and successor backend-basis capture together. Preserve the existing publication authority and prepared maintenance lifetime/WaitThrough; do not introduce foreground physical checkpoint or a second publisher. Fresh/reopen and legacy nonempty-DATA rebuild/refusal, side-store isolation, canonical format/profile docs and matched costs belong to the existing #5111 completion packet. Closed #5118 stays closed. #4878 must consume the actual composite cut's producer-maintained ordered sources, exact backend basis and genuine physical custody; a backend-only PRIMARY certificate does not describe the whole public cut. A deeper replacement is conditional on a concrete failed boundedness invariant, not on foreground constructor counts. All original gates remain required.

Accepted decision and source links: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6158172698
**Recovery/cache decision (2026-10-14):** Existing cache persistence lacks a durable name-to-file baseline, so flushed poisoning of the current cache alone cannot exclude resurrection of another older object. Extend the SAME derived refcount tracker/cache with a CRC-covered exact physical-pair binding carried with counts from their original Snapshot through every load/scan/activation/audit/delta/revision/persistence consumer; old v5 metadata is a cache miss/rebuild. Do not create another registry or assign old counts a later generation. Same-canonical-pair completed COMMIT idempotence is conditional on full ordinary current/other-slot/embedded-parent/dependency recovery validation; identity matching alone cannot waive historical-generation, namespace cleanup or refund gates. Different-pair old decisions refuse. Preserve the platform contract: eligible namespace operations require the exact authorized handle and a genuine persistence barrier, checked last Close and retained failure debt; unsupported creation/rename/unlink must fail closed before effects. Required Windows CI remains required. This does not add a full Windows feature-support obligation or a new hardware campaign. Decision, source and exact report: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6158492710. These repairs remain in the existing #5111 closure with all original gates and one writer.



**Verified ordinary shared-completion checkpoint (2026-10-14):** Production `472079d249e6a28d4ed47a6a9e9f0b4be60ddc9f`, artifact-only `725c31dd2711467514a91df9847e2e303b719afd`; exact-source focused normal/race and real original PRIMARY close/public GetMany controls verified. [Receipt and remaining gates](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6159259564). This preserves original finalizer/custody and capture-time physical lifetime; it is partial construction evidence. PR #5127 remains draft at its existing head. Next ordinary work is SAME physical-incarnation cache/recovery and all19/value/leaf/cost/platform/CI/review. Native #4878 remains disjoint provisional construction with all original outcome gates.

**Tree/node checkpoint and capture seam (2026-10-14):** [https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4878#issuecomment-6159668506](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4878#issuecomment-6159668506) accepts source `87b75db0f866a3cdc5cfd2ad1a9aa1f122279d0d` as verified provisional construction only, with normal/safe/race controls and exact source/artifact closure. Native external frame I/O, large reconstructed keys, composite integration and physical Finish remain required. Exactly 94 released fixture directories (18,939,904 allocated bytes) were deleted and their absence independently verified; committed inventory/raw evidence retained. Prefer carrying the existing producer certificate on the SAME retained immutable PRIMARY root: #5111 covers every producer/recovery/rebuild/capture constructor and descriptor-size admission once, with exact Arena/PageID/incarnation binding and fresh consumer CRC/digest. This avoids cold bank rediscovery without another authority. No readiness inferred from the pointer alone; all original caps and outcome gates remain open. The sole native worker continues disjoint tree/node codec and geometry support.

**Retained count storage correction (2026-10-14):** [source-bound decision](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6160040407) removes the original collector-to-tracker map clone and requires truthful original backing-capacity admission. Use one explicit-capacity count array in the SAME collector/candidate/tracker, transfer once, reserve growth/overlap before effects and release only after the actual last alias. Preserve expected update complexity, canonical cache format, physical binding, original corruption/revision semantics and post-ACK invalidation rules. This is implementation in the existing all19 packet, not acceptance or a new registry; complete source/normal/race/cost/platform/review/CI gates remain open.

**Shared physical transaction disposal and count lifetime (2026-10-14):** [Selected complete lifecycle repair](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6160472358) extends the [first genuine late-root refusal decision](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6160347399) across original Abort, Finish, recovery, every install abort defer, Close and vacuum. Separate actual consumption from final success; preserve first failure/progress and prevent repeated consumed drops. Roots precede resource release, actual pin refunds follow consumption, and failed-finishing/already-consumed-Set originals remain in recovery custody. Void release or Released ownership alone cannot certify physical success. Embed failure receipts in the SAME admitted originals and retain siblings through existing DB.bgErr/closeTeardownErr before notification; no new registry/keeper. DB-lived counts use the existing identity-registry MetadataOwner from producer creation, retaining separate exact physical incarnation, with actual post-cutover growth/scan proof. Complete containing admission, genuine partial/failure/reentrant controls and every original all19/format/fault/value/leaf/cost/platform/review/CI gate in one #5111 packet; no per-defect push/review cycle.

Keeping that production-used work unlanded until native pruning fits its budget creates avoidable integration churn. Land the ordinary closure independently, preserving every durability, reader and persistent-value dependency. Completion here does not qualify native pruning, enable M8, or close #4878/#4871.

**Structural retention revision (2026-10-08):** Promotion currently adds the coalesced dependency-bank closure to a logical PRIMARY read root that can already be held by an admitted relaxed Snapshot. In the SAME existing transaction/coordinator/seal/slot, acquire a genuine reference to that original immutable logical root and hold the dependency/manifest edge and capsule-image allocation charge independently in the existing slot/seal. No second publisher, generic ownership framework, unlimited rollback or hidden borrowed proof. [Source-supported design and stop criteria](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6189177394); this is not yet a safety, bounded-ACK or cost acceptance.
